title: Reviews
description: View ratings and reviews left by customers.

help.title: About reviews
help.overview: Ratings and comments clients leave on finished orders. They give each listing its rating and review count, and you your rating as a provider.

sections.title: Each review
items: Only the order's client can review it, once, after it's completed. Clients can also review from their account.
Reviews can't be edited once written, and nobody in your company can delete one: they're published as clients wrote them.
If a review breaks the rules, report it to the platform from its ⋯ menu. Only the platform can hide a review; a hidden one leaves your rating and shows here as Hidden by the platform.
